title: "Very much baecation:" Fans react to cozy pictures of Justin Bieber with wife Hailey shared by the singer - NewsBreak
text: Justin Bieber has given fans another glimpse into his couples retreat by posting an endearing photo with his wife, Hailey Bieber. The photograph shared via the singer's official Instagram account on June 9 shows Hailey gazing out at the water as Justin embraces her, while the two sit by the waterfront marinas of Mallorca. The post was accompanied by several heart-eyed emojis and has caused a stir on social media. Justin and Hailey are currently staying in Spain as part of a romantic getaway, which also serves as the promotional tour for the latter's cosmetic brand, Rhode Skin. The two have regularly been posting updates from their jaunt, and were also recently photographed by Splash News having lunch together while outdoors. ​ ​ Justin Bieber 's recent PDA-filled post comes just 3 days after he shared another cozy photo with Hailey. Even with rumors of marriage problems continuing to make headlines, the post has been met with positive responses from fans on social media, with fans expressing their support for the couple in full voice. One fan ( @olabeeisi ) commented: Another fan ( @laviniahcec ) quipped: A third fan ( @ilovebiebersj ) wrote: With the photo causing a wave of reactions on social media, while some believe that it is an indication that everything is fine in the Bieber household, others have launched a barrage of speculations, jokes, and trolls on the couple. The simple act of Justin resting her head on Hailey's shoulders also came under attack, with dozens of users poking fun at the situation by referring to Justin Bieber's past track record. One fan (@ ambergerger ) wondered: Yet another fan ( @chinodoublea) joked: Some users have been sympathetic towards the couple, while others decided to make fun of the fact that, since the woman's back was turned, her identity would be subject to speculations in the eyes of certain viewers. While the debates raged on, others joined in the conversation, attempting to put an end to them. One fan ( @whoisbay ) wrote: Another fan ( @dilena_the_star ) chimed in: ​ The photograph appears to show Hailey and Justin Bieber displaying a united front in the face of rumors of a rift between the couple. The singer has also posted a couple of pictures and videos of his playtime with his son, Jack Blues , with Hailey also becoming an increasingly regular feature on his social media accounts. Despite their alleged marriage issues that several sources have revealed, the couple appears committed to working through their troubles. ​
